summary: Phase 2 SAI regression on mobile viewport (390x844). Previous Ask SAI blocker (submit off-viewport) is FIXED — sheet now uses fullHeight + KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView; submit tappable and answer renders. Core flows verified: header (search/notifications/AskSAI/role switcher), bottom tabs, Command Center KPIs and priority list, Leads pipeline with 6 stages, Lead detail sheet with Client 360 + matches + stage buttons, Inbox with channel filters + converted badges, Global search returning grouped results (Leads/Tasks/Inbox), Notifications sheet, Admin dashboard (KPIs + revenue by agent + agent performance + Commission tool), Add Lead sheet fields fill, auto-assignment to lightest-load agent (Priya Menon) and toast/notification generated. Local persistence via AsyncStorage confirmed — after Create Lead, `sai:v1:leads` in localStorage contains the new record and it survives reload (the record just doesn't render in Agent view because it was auto-routed to another agent — this is by design). Deprecated RN Web props detected: `shadow*` and `props.pointerEvents`.

ui_bugs.component: AddMenu bottom sheet (quick-lead / quick-task / quick-property / quick-ask)
ui_bugs.issue: Playwright reports the picker rows as 'outside of viewport' on some cold-open attempts even though getBoundingClientRect shows them at top=504/bottom=573 (in-frame). A JS-dispatched click works, but Playwright's force-click occasionally fails. Suggests a pointer-events / animation-timing race between the Modal opening and the child Pressables becoming hit-testable. On real mobile devices a quick double-tap may miss.

ui_bugs.component: Form fields in AddLeadSheet / AddPropertySheet / AddTaskSheet
ui_bugs.issue: Only `input-name` and `create-lead` have testIDs. Phone/email/budget/bedrooms/area/notes fields have neither testID nor unique accessibility label — automated regression must fall back to placeholder matching.
ui_bugs.testID: input-phone / input-email / input-budget / input-bedrooms / input-area / input-notes (missing)

issues: 'SMART AGENT INTELLIGENCE' tag is 7px which is well below the 11px minimum for readable body text — acceptable as a decorative brandTag but flagging for accessibility awareness.

react_native_issues.component: Multiple components (Header, BottomTabs, and anywhere using shadow* styles)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Migrate shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset to a single `boxShadow` string (RN Web SDK 53+ style contract). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BottomTabs.tsx around the `addBtn` style; /app/frontend/src/components/Header.tsx and any other shadow* usage.

react_native_issues.component: Any component setting `pointerEvents` as a prop
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move `pointerEvents="..."` from JSX props into `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`.

action_items: Add testID props to all inputs in AddLeadSheet, AddPropertySheet, AddTaskSheet (phone/email/budget/bedrooms/area/notes/title/price/etc.) so future regression can fill by testID rather than fragile placeholder matching.

Investigate AddMenu tap race — the Modal Pressable rows sometimes need a ~200ms settle before automated clicks land. Consider disabling child pointer events until the sheet slide-in animation completes, or explicitly delaying the `onPick` fire until animation end.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to clear the RN Web deprecation warning.
Move `pointerEvents` from JSX props into `style.pointerEvents` for the same reason.
Optional: expose an in-app hint or a subtle badge that leads auto-assigned to other agents are visible under the Admin role — QA on Agent view initially mistook auto-assigned leads for 'lost' data.
critical_code_review_comments: AsyncStorage-wrapped persistence relies on doubled JSON.stringify (once in AppContext.save, once in Storage.setItem). It happens to round-trip correctly because storage-base.retrieve does JSON.parse once and AppContext.load does JSON.parse again, but this is fragile — if a future refactor removes one of the two JSON.parse layers, all persistence will silently fall back to seed data. Consider consolidating: either storage.setItem takes raw values (no inner stringify) or AppContext.save stops wrapping.
Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the platform contract references EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Currently harmless (backend-less app) but should be aligned before any future live-API work.

Many Pressable actions (More screen module cards, admin tool cards, task rows, message rows, priority lead rows on home) lack testIDs even though the design/testing contract requires testID on all interactive elements. This makes robust regression brittle.

rca_of_issue: Previous iteration flagged Ask SAI submit as unreachable at 390x844. Root cause was BottomSheet maxHeight:88% with no scroll on the modal card. Current build now wraps children in a ScrollView + KeyboardAvoidingView and AskSaiSheet passes fullHeight (maxHeight:95%). Verified: [data-testid=ask-submit] is now inside the viewport after typing, click succeeds without a scroll-into-view fallback, and [data-testid=ask-answer] renders with the expected 'Priorities for today' payload. Previous blocker resolved.
